# Test certificates

Generated by `scripts/gen-testdata-certs.sh` and committed so that a fresh
clone passes `make test` without running the script.

Every key here is a throwaway generated for the test suite. They are only ever
served on `127.0.0.1` by `internal/probe`'s tests. Do not reuse them anywhere.

| File | What it is for |
|---|---|
| `ca.cert.pem`, `ca.key.pem` | Local CA, added to the test client's root pool |
| `good.*` | Valid chain, correct SAN, 2048-bit RSA, SHA-256 |
| `expiring.*` | Valid, but expires in 10 days |
| `expired.*` | `notAfter` in 2021 |
| `wronghost.*` | Valid chain, SAN that does not cover `localhost` |
| `selfsigned.*` | Chains to nothing |
| `weakkey.*` | 1024-bit RSA |
| `sha1.*` | SHA-1 signature |
